ajoutes.label: Merge Group
ajoutes.params: {"layer":id?}

ajoutes.label: Move Document
ajoutes.params: {"document":index?,"to":index}

ajoutes.label: Edit Layer Style
ajoutes.params: {"layer":id,"effects":[{"kind":"dropShadow|innerShadow|outerGlow|innerGlow|stroke|colorOverlay|gradientOverlay|patternOverlay|satin|bevelEmboss","params":{…layer.layerStyle.<kind> params…},"fx":<effect snapshot carried through the Layer Style dialog, optional>}]} (replaces the layer's whole effect list; an entry with `fx` edits that effect with the params present, one without builds from params)

ajoutes.label: Make Layer Style Default
ajoutes.params: {"kind":"stroke|dropShadow|innerShadow|outerGlow|innerGlow|colorOverlay|gradientOverlay|patternOverlay|satin|bevelEmboss","params":{…param set…}} (stores the user default the Layer Style dialog's Reset to Default restores)

ajoutes.label: Layer Style Default
ajoutes.params: {"kind":str} → {"params":{…},"user":bool} (the saved user default, else the factory defaults)

ajoutes.label: List Layers
ajoutes.params: {"document":index?,"flat":bool=false} → {"layers":[{"id","name","kind","visible","bounds":[x,y,w,h]|null,"selected","active","children"?}],"activeLayer":id?} (top-down; groups list their "children", or with "flat" every layer is one row with its "depth" and "parent" group id)

ajoutes.label: Color to Alpha…
ajoutes.params: {"color":color=#ffffff,"transparencyThreshold":0..1=0,"opacityThreshold":0..1=1}

ajoutes.label: Solid Color…
ajoutes.params: {"layer":id? (default active),"document":id? (reject a stale dialog),"color":"#rrggbb"|"#rrggbbaa"|[r,g,b,a?]|{mode,c:[f32;4],alpha:f32}}; RGB values without alpha preserve it; stored Color preserves its model and precision

ajoutes.label: Pattern Fill…
ajoutes.params: {"layer":id? (default active; a Pattern Fill layer),"document":id? (reject a stale dialog),"pattern":id|name?,"scale":1..1000?,"angle":-180..180?,"link":bool?,"phase":[x,y]? (Snap to Origin: [0,0])}; omitted values keep the layer's

ajoutes.label: Increase Type Size
ajoutes.params: {"layer":id?,"range":[startChar,endChar]? (default all),"by":pt? (as the layer appears)}

ajoutes.label: Decrease Type Size
ajoutes.params: {"layer":id?,"range":[startChar,endChar]? (default all),"by":pt? (as the layer appears)}

ajoutes.label: Increase Type Size by 10
ajoutes.params: {"layer":id?,"range":[startChar,endChar]? (default all),"by":pt? (as the layer appears)}

ajoutes.label: Decrease Type Size by 10
ajoutes.params: {"layer":id?,"range":[startChar,endChar]? (default all),"by":pt? (as the layer appears)}

ajoutes.label: Type Mask
ajoutes.params: {"layer":id? (a type layer whose glyphs become the selection),"removeLayer":bool=false (delete that layer in the same step: the Type Mask tools' temporary text),"operation":"new|add|subtract|intersect"="new","antialias":"none|sharp|crisp|strong|smooth"?, …without "layer", type.create's keys: "text","x","y" or "box","orientation","font","size","align",…}

ajoutes.label: Float Selection
ajoutes.params: {"dx":px=0,"dy":px=0,"copy":bool=false,"target":"pixels"|"mask"="pixels" (mask: float the selected part of the layer's mask, the hole takes the background colour)} → {layer, offset} (cuts the selected pixels of the active layer into a floating piece the first time, or with copy leaves them and floats a duplicate; on the Background the hole takes the background colour; then moves it by whole pixels; dropped by select.drop or any other command, put back by edit.undo)

ajoutes.label: Drop Floating Selection
ajoutes.params: {} → {dropped, offset} (drops the floating piece into its layer and moves the selection with it: one history step)

ajoutes.label: Free Transform Path
ajoutes.params: {"name":str|"work"|"layer"="work","layer":id? (with layer target),"matrix":[a,b,c,d,e,f] | "quad":[[x,y]×4] (Distort/Perspective: where the frame's corners go, clockwise from top-left) | "style"|"mesh"|"warp":… (Warp, as edit.transform.warp) | "translateX":px?,"translateY":px?,"scaleX":factor?,"scaleY":factor?,"angle":degrees?,"rect":[x0,y0,x1,y1]? (the quad's or warp's frame; default = path control bounds)} (numeric transforms pivot on path bounds center)

ajoutes.label: Clipping Path
ajoutes.params: {"name":savedPathName,"flatness":0..100=0} (PSD export clipping path)

ajoutes.label: Copy Fill
ajoutes.params: {} (copies active shape layer fill)

ajoutes.label: Copy Complete Stroke
ajoutes.params: {} (copies active shape layer stroke)

ajoutes.label: Paste Fill
ajoutes.params: {"layer":id?} (pastes copied fill onto active shape layer)

ajoutes.label: Paste Complete Stroke
ajoutes.params: {"layer":id?} (pastes copied stroke onto active shape layer)

ajoutes.label: Drag Anchor Points
ajoutes.params: {"name":str|"work"|"layer"="work","layer":id? (with "layer": a shape layer's path or a vector mask),"anchors":[[subpath,knot],…],"move":[dx,dy],"curvature":bool=false (anchors move with their handles; Direct Selection drag. curvature = the Curvature Pen's drag: every smooth knot of the touched subpaths gets its handles recomputed so the curve flows through the anchors)} → {name,path}

ajoutes.label: Drag Direction Point
ajoutes.params: {"name":str|"work"|"layer"="work","layer":id? (with "layer": a shape layer's path or a vector mask),"subpath":i,"knot":j,"handle":"in|out","to":[x,y],"independent":bool=false (a smooth point turns its other handle to stay collinear; independent = ⌥ / Convert Point, makes a corner)} → {name,path}

ajoutes.label: Drag Segment
ajoutes.params: {"name":str|"work"|"layer"="work","layer":id? (with "layer": a shape layer's path or a vector mask),"subpath":i,"knot":j (the segment leaving it),"t":0..1=0.5 (where it was grabbed),"move":[dx,dy] (a straight segment moves with its anchors; a curve reshapes through the dragged point)} → {name,path}

ajoutes.label: Convert Point
ajoutes.params: {"name":str|"work"|"layer"="work","layer":id? (with "layer": a shape layer's path or a vector mask),"subpath":i,"knot":j,"out":[x,y]? (none: corner with retracted handles; given: smooth with this out handle and its mirror),"curvature":bool=false (the Curvature Pen's double-click: toggles smooth/corner and reflows the smooth knots of the subpath; out ignored)} → {name,path}

ajoutes.label: Add Anchor Point
ajoutes.params: {"name":str|"work"|"layer"="work","layer":id? (with "layer": a shape layer's path or a vector mask),"subpath":i,"knot":j (the segment leaving it),"t":0<t<1=0.5 (where on the segment) (a curve is split there without changing its shape and gets a smooth anchor; a straight segment gets a corner) (the result also has anchor:{subpath,knot})} → {name,path}

ajoutes.label: Delete Anchor Point
ajoutes.params: {"name":str|"work"|"layer"="work","layer":id? (with "layer": a shape layer's path or a vector mask),"subpath":i,"knot":j (its neighbours are joined, keeping their handles; a subpath's last anchor removes the subpath; the path's only anchor is refused) (the result also has subpathRemoved:bool)} → {name,path}

ajoutes.label: Remove Background
ajoutes.params: {"layer":id?,"sampleAllLayers":bool=false,"refine":bool=true} → {layer,bounds} (adds a layer mask from Select Subject; the Background becomes a normal layer)

ajoutes.label: Set Painting Symmetry
ajoutes.params: {"mode":"vertical|horizontal|dual|diagonal","center":[x,y]?,"rotation":degrees=0}

ajoutes.label: Make Symmetry Path
ajoutes.params: {"name":"work"|"layer"|savedPathName="work"} — mirror Brush, Pencil and Eraser strokes across the path

ajoutes.label: Edit Guide
ajoutes.params: {"orientation":"horizontal|vertical","index":n,"newOrientation":"horizontal|vertical"?,"position":px or "<number><unit>"?,"color":name or "#rrggbb"?} (Edit Selected Guides: units and colours as for view.newGuide; % is of the new orientation's extent; whatever is left out stays as it was)

ajoutes.label: Set Ruler Origin
ajoutes.params: {"x":px,"y":px} (the rulers' zero point in document pixels; the rulers and Info panel measure from it)

ajoutes.label: Reset Ruler Origin
ajoutes.params: {} (zero point back at the image's top-left)

ajoutes.label: Update Brush Preset
ajoutes.params: {"name":string?=the preset the current brush was picked from,"brush":{…BrushSettings}?=current brush}

ajoutes.label: Set Current Brush Preset
ajoutes.params: {"name":string}

ajoutes.label: Import Brush from Image…
ajoutes.params: {"path":"image file (PNG, JPEG, TIFF, PSD…)"?,"data":base64 bytes?,"fileName":string? (with data: the file's name, for its format and the default preset name),"name":string?=file name,"select":bool=true (make it the current brush)} → {name, width, height}

ajoutes.label: Load Actions…
ajoutes.params: {"path":".atn file"?,"data":base64 bytes?,"set":name? (override the file's set name),"replace":bool=true (replace the actions of a set of the same name)} → {set, actions:[names], steps, unsupported:[{action, step, event, name}], functionKeys:[{action, key}], warnings}. Photoshop steps PhotoCraft cannot play become actions.photoshopStep steps (kept for Save Actions; they fail at playback with the step's name); tool selections and other steps with no document effect are imported switched off. Layer references by name replay in any document.

ajoutes.label: Save Actions…
ajoutes.params: {"path":".atn file"? (else the bytes come back as base64 `data`),"set":name? (that set's actions; default: every action, as the set "PhotoCraft Actions"),"action":name|index? (one action),"skipUnsupported":bool=false (leave out steps with no Photoshop equivalent instead of failing)} → {set, actions:[names], steps, bytes, skipped:[{action, step, id}], path|data}

ajoutes.label: Stop
ajoutes.params: {"message":str,"allowContinue":bool=false} (Photoshop's Insert Stop: a step that shows the message; headless playback continues when allowContinue is set and otherwise stops the action with the message)

ajoutes.label: Photoshop Step
ajoutes.params: {"event":id,"name":str,"descriptor":base64?} (a step from a .atn file PhotoCraft has no command for: fails at playback, written back by actions.save)

ajoutes.label: Insert Step
ajoutes.params: {"action":name|index, "id":command id, "params":{}?, "at":index?=end} → {action, step, id, steps}. Inserts a step at the 0-based position (Photoshop's Insert Stop… with id actions.stopMessage, Insert Menu Item… with any command). Pending recorded steps count; flags of the steps after it follow them.

ajoutes.label: Toggle Step Dialog
ajoutes.params: {"action":name|index, "step":index?, "enabled":bool?} → {action, dialogs:[step…]}. The Actions panel's dialog toggle: the desktop shell shows the step's dialog, seeded with its recorded params, and resumes playback when it is confirmed; headless playback runs the recorded params. Omitted enabled flips it; without step, every step: on unless all already are, or as enabled says.

ajoutes.label: Conditional
ajoutes.params: {"if":condition, "then":action name|null, "else":action name|null} → {if, holds, played, ran?, failed?}. Photoshop's Insert Conditional: conditions always|never|isOpen|landscape|square|portrait|modeIsRGB|modeIsCMYK|modeIsGrayscale|modeIsLab|modeIsBitmap|modeIsIndexed|modeIsDuotone|modeIsMultichannel|depth8|depth16|depth32|unsaved|hasSelection|hasLayers|hasAlphaChannels|isBackground|isPixelLayer|isAdjustmentLayer|isShapeLayer|isTypeLayer|isSmartObject|isLayerGroup|isLocked|isVisible|hasPixelMask|hasVectorMask|hasEffects (layer conditions test the active layer). The branch plays as actions.play does; its failure stops the calling action.

ajoutes.label: Move to Set
ajoutes.params: {"action":name|index, "set":name|null} → {action, set}. The set folder the Actions panel shows the action under (what Load Actions fills and Save Actions writes); null takes it out of any set.

ajoutes.label: Swatches
ajoutes.params: {} → {groups:[{name,swatches:[{name,model,values,hex,kind?}]}],count}. values are in Color Picker units; hex is the colour in the RGB working space.

ajoutes.label: New Swatch…
ajoutes.params: {"color":"#rrggbb"|{"model":"rgb|hsb|cmyk|lab|gray","values":[rgb 0..255 | hue°,s%,b% | c%,m%,y%,k% | L,a,b | k%]}?=foreground,"name":str?="Color Swatch N","group":name?=first (created when missing),"index":n?=end,"kind":"process|global|spot"="process"} → {name,group,index}

ajoutes.label: Delete Swatch
ajoutes.params: {"swatch":name (or "index":n across all groups),"group":name? (narrows the name lookup); "swatch" may be a list of names} → {deleted:[names]}

ajoutes.label: Rename Swatch…
ajoutes.params: {"swatch":name (or "index":n across all groups),"group":name? (narrows the name lookup),"name":str} → {name}

ajoutes.label: Move Swatch
ajoutes.params: {"swatch":name (or "index":n across all groups),"group":name? (narrows the name lookup),"to":group?=its own group,"position":n?=end} → {group,position}

ajoutes.label: New Swatch Group…
ajoutes.params: {"name":str="Group" (made unique),"swatches":[names]? (moved into the new group)} → {group,moved}

ajoutes.label: Rename Swatch Group…
ajoutes.params: {"group":name,"name":str} → {group}

ajoutes.label: Delete Swatch Group
ajoutes.params: {"group":name,"keepSwatches":bool=false (move its swatches into the group above)} → {group,deleted|kept}

ajoutes.label: Use Swatch
ajoutes.params: {"swatch":name (or "index":n across all groups),"group":name? (narrows the name lookup),"target":"foreground|background"="foreground"} → {swatch,target,hex}. CMYK, Lab and gray swatches are converted to the RGB working space with colour management.

ajoutes.label: Reset Swatches
ajoutes.params: {"append":bool=false (add the defaults instead of replacing the library)} → {groups,count}

ajoutes.label: Import Swatches…
ajoutes.params: {"path":".aco or .ase file"?,"data":base64 bytes?,"format":"aco|ase"? (detected),"mode":"append|replace"="append","group":str?=file name (the group for ungrouped colours)} → {format,mode,groups,count,warnings}

ajoutes.label: Export Swatches…
ajoutes.params: {"format":"aco|ase"?=from path, else aco,"path":file? (else the bytes come back as base64 `data`),"group":name? (only that group),"swatches":[names]? (only these)} → {format,count,bytes,warnings,path|data}

ajoutes.label: Pattern Stamp
ajoutes.params: {"points":[[x,y,pressure?],…],"size":1..5000 px=tool size,"hardness":0..100=tool hardness,"opacity":1..100=100,"flow":1..100=100,"spacing":1..1000 (% of size)=Brush Settings spacing,"layer":id?=active,"target":"pixels"|"mask"|"quickMask"|{"channel":i}=Channels panel target,"pattern":id|name?=Patterns panel current,"scale":1..1000 %=100,"angle":deg=0,"aligned":bool=true,"impressionist":bool=false,"mode":"normal|multiply|…"="normal","phase":[px,py]? → {"damage","phase","aligned","pattern"}}

ajoutes.label: Patch
ajoutes.params: {"offset":[dx,dy] (how far the selection was dragged),"mode":"source|destination"="source","contentAware":bool=false (fill the selection content-aware from the dragged-to place; a background job),"structure":1..7=4 (content-aware: 3..7 copy the middle exactly, 1..2 re-synthesise more of it),"color":0..10=0 (content-aware: how far the copy's level adapts to the selection's surroundings),"sampleAllLayers":bool=false (content-aware),"layer":id?=active,"target":"pixels"|"mask"|"quickMask"|{"channel":i}=Channels panel target} → {"damage","offset"}

ajoutes.label: Content-Aware Move
ajoutes.params: {"offset":[dx,dy] (how far the selection was dragged),"mode":"move|extend"="move","structure":1..7=4 (3..7 copy the content exactly but for a band about a patch wide along its edge; 2 widens the band, 1 re-synthesises the content too),"color":0..10=0 (0 keeps the content's level; higher values bring it towards its new place, by up to about 0.04 × color),"sampleAllLayers":bool=false,"scaleX":%=100,"scaleY":%=100 (Transform On Drop: 1..10000, negative flips),"rotate":deg=0 (Transform On Drop, clockwise; scale and rotation are about the selection's centre, before the offset; a transformed patch may reach past the canvas edge),"layer":id?=active,"target":"pixels"|"mask"|"quickMask"|{"channel":i}=Channels panel target} → {"damage","offset","mode","transformed"?} (a background job; the selection moves, and is transformed, with the content)

ajoutes.label: Remove
ajoutes.params: {"points":[[x,y,pressure?],…],"size":1..5000 px=tool size,"hardness":0..100=tool hardness,"opacity":1..100=100,"flow":1..100=100,"spacing":1..1000 (% of size)=Brush Settings spacing,"layer":id?=active,"target":"pixels"|"mask"|"quickMask"|{"channel":i}=Channels panel target,"strokes":[[[x,y,pressure?],…],…]? (several strokes removed together, as one job and one undo step; else "points"),"closeLoops":bool=true (a stroke around an object removes what it encloses),"sampleAllLayers":bool=false,"newLayer":bool=false (the fill goes to a new layer above the target, which stays as it was) → {"damage","layer"?} (a background job)}

ajoutes.label: Red Eye
ajoutes.params: {"x":px, "y":px} | {"points":[[x,y],…] (at most 64)},"pupilSize":1..100=50,"darken":0..100=50,"layer":id?=active,"target":"pixels"|"mask"|"quickMask"|{"channel":i} → {"damage":[x,y,w,h], "pixels":n}

ajoutes.label: Perspective Crop
ajoutes.params: {"corners":[[x,y],[x,y],[x,y],[x,y]] (top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left; a convex quad, document px),"width":px,"height":px,"resolution":ppi,"interpolation":"bicubic|bilinear|nearest"="bicubic"} → {width,height,resolution,corners} (the quad is mapped onto an upright width x height canvas, all layers, one undo step; no width/height: the quad's mean side lengths, one alone keeps its proportions; type, shape, fill and smart object layers are rasterized)

ajoutes.label: Magnetic Lasso
ajoutes.params: {"points":[[x,y],…] (≥3 fastening points in order; with trace=false, the finished outline),"width":1..256=10 (px: follows edges this close to the points),"contrast":1..100=10 (%: weaker edges are ignored),"close":"magnetic|straight"="magnetic" (how the last point joins the first),"trace":bool=true,"mode":"replace|add|subtract|intersect"="replace","antiAlias":bool=true,"feather":0..1000=0 (px)}

ajoutes.label: Lock Transparent Pixels
ajoutes.params: {"layer":id?} (toggles; several layers selected: locks them all unless every one is locked)

ajoutes.label: Show Only This Layer
ajoutes.params: {"layer":id?} → {shownAlone} (⌥-click a layer's eye; again restores the other layers' visibility)

ajoutes.label: Background From Layer
ajoutes.params: {"layer":id?} (the active layer by default; transparent pixels take the background colour and the layer drops to the bottom as the locked Background)

ajoutes.label: Reveal in Finder
ajoutes.params: {"document":index? (default active),"dryRun":bool=false}

ajoutes.label: EXR Parts Info
ajoutes.params: {"path":str (the EXR file)}

ajoutes.label: Open EXR Parts…
ajoutes.params: {"path":str (the EXR file),"view":"both|left|right"="both","part/<name>":bool (import this part as a layer),"group/<name>":bool (import this channel group as a layer),"precomp":bool=false (add the additive beauty precomp from the AOVs)}

ajoutes.label: Type on a Path
ajoutes.params: {"layer":id? (default active Type layer),"shape":layerId? (a shape layer; default the work path),"subpath":index=0,"start":px=0 (offset along the path),"flip":bool=false (run along the path the other way, on its other side)}

ajoutes.label: Release Type from Path
ajoutes.params: {"layer":id?}

ajoutes.label: Hit-Test Type
ajoutes.params: {"layer":id?, "x":px, "y":px} → {"layer","index":char,"line","inside":bool}. No layer: the topmost visible type layer whose laid-out text or rendered pixels contain the point (same order as the Type tool); a miss is an error. With a layer, index is the nearest caret even when inside is false

ajoutes.label: Type Caret
ajoutes.params: {"layer":id?, "index":char (0..=length; empty text is 0)} → {"index","line","segment":[[x,y],[x,y]]} caret segment in document pixels, for rotated and vertical type too

ajoutes.label: Navigate Type
ajoutes.params: {"layer":id?, "index":char, "move":"wordPrev|wordNext|linePrev|lineNext|lineStart|lineEnd|start|end", "x":px?} → {"index"}. Words are alphanumeric runs. x is the document x to keep across linePrev/lineNext (a caret segment's x); omitted uses the caret's own column. Empty text returns index 0

ajoutes.label: Update Changed Linked Content
ajoutes.params: {} — re-render the active document's linked smart objects whose files changed on disk since they were last seen (size or modification time); the desktop app does this by itself every two seconds, as Photoshop does while a document is open. Files seen for the first time are only remembered. One Update Modified Content undo step per file → {updated: [layer ids]}

ajoutes.label: Convert to Layers
ajoutes.params: {"layer":id?} (contents unpacked at the placement: one layer, or a group named after the smart object; smart filters are discarded)

ajoutes.label: Move or Copy Smart Filters
ajoutes.params: {"from":id,"to":id,"filter":u32? (default: all, with the filter mask),"copy":bool=false}

ajoutes.label: Copy Layers to Document
ajoutes.params: {"document":index (destination),"layers":[id,…]?=the source's selected layers,"source":index?=active,"center":bool=false (centre on the destination's canvas),"at":[x,y]? (centre the copies on this point),"offset":[dx,dy]?=[0,0] (from their place in the source),"name":str? (one layer: the copy's name)}

ajoutes.label: Fill from History
ajoutes.params: {"state":n? (default: the History Brush's source, the oldest state still held),"layer":id?,"target":"pixels"|"mask"|"quickMask"|{"channel":i}?,"preserveTransparency":bool?}

ajoutes.label: Sample Color
ajoutes.params: {"x":f64,"y":f64,"size":"point"|1|3|5|11|31|51|101=1,"sampleLayer":"current"|"currentAndBelow"|"all"|"allNoAdjustments"|"currentAndBelowNoAdjustments"="all"} → [r,g,b,a] (the Eyedropper's Sample Size and Sample: the composite pixel, or the average of the size×size square centred on it, clipped to the canvas; transparent off the canvas)

ajoutes.label: Detect Faces
ajoutes.params: {"minScore":0..1=0.5,"sampleAllLayers":bool=true} → {"faces":[{"score","rect":[x,y,w,h],"landmarks":{"rightEye","leftEye","nose","mouthRight","mouthLeft"}: [x,y] each},…]} (best first; "rightEye" is the one on the image's left)

ajoutes.label: Add Color Sampler
ajoutes.params: {"x":f64,"y":f64} → the new point {index, number, position, rgb, cmyk}; errors at the 10-point limit or off the canvas

ajoutes.label: Delete Color Sampler
ajoutes.params: {"index":n}

ajoutes.label: Color Samplers
ajoutes.params: {} → {max, samplers:[{index, number, position, rgb, cmyk}]}

ajoutes.label: Rotate Brush Tip
ajoutes.params: {"degrees":-360..360 (positive anticlockwise; ← / → while painting send 1, ⇧ 15)}

ajoutes.label: Move Layer Effects
ajoutes.params: {"from":id,"to":id,"effect":index? (default: all effects),"copy":bool=false}

ajoutes.label: Layer Color
ajoutes.params: {"color":"none|red|orange|yellow|green|seafoam|blue|indigo|magenta|fuchsia|violet|gray","layer":id?} (no layer: selected layers; groups include descendants)

ajoutes.label: Warp Grid
ajoutes.params: {"warp":{…}? (the warp being edited; returned with the new mesh),"rect":[x0,y0,x1,y1]?,"size":n|"default"|"3"|"4"|"5" (square patches, 1..=64; 1 and "default" are the single-patch grid)} — without `warp`/`style`/`mesh`, edits the active smart object's warp. The surface is kept and the new lines are real splits at i/n.

ajoutes.label: Add Artboard Beside
ajoutes.params: {"layer":id? (default: the active artboard),"side":"left|right|top|bottom"="right","duplicate":bool=false (copy the board with its contents instead of an empty one)} → {layer, rect} (the Artboard tool's "+" buttons: same size, a 100 px gap away, past any board in the way)

ajoutes.label: Undo
ajoutes.params: {} (the same action as `edit.undo`)

ajoutes.label: Redo
ajoutes.params: {} (the same action as `edit.redo`)

ajoutes.label: Delete State
ajoutes.params: {"state":index?} (History entry, 0 = oldest; default the current state) → {states,current}: removes the state and every later one

ajoutes.label: New Document from State
ajoutes.params: {"state":index?,"name":str?} (History entry, 0 = oldest; default the current state) → {document,name}

ajoutes.label: New Snapshot
ajoutes.params: {"name":str?="Snapshot N","from":"fullDocument"|"mergedLayers"|"currentLayer"="fullDocument"} → {snapshot,name}: a named copy of the document for the session (not a history state)

ajoutes.label: Select Snapshot
ajoutes.params: {"snapshot":id} → {snapshot,name}: the document returns to the snapshot as a new history state named after it

ajoutes.label: Rename Snapshot
ajoutes.params: {"snapshot":id,"name":str} → {snapshot,name}

ajoutes.label: Delete Snapshot
ajoutes.params: {"snapshot":id} → {snapshot,snapshots}: the document and its history are unchanged

ajoutes.label: Select History State
ajoutes.params: {"state":index} (History entry as the panel lists them: 0 = oldest, then the current state, then the redo states) → {state,changed,current?}: returns the document to that state in one step; the states after it stay redoable

ajoutes.label: Edit Gradient Stop
ajoutes.params: {"action":"add|move|delete|color|opacity","kind":"color|opacity"="color","index":stop number,"location":0..1,"color":"#rrggbb"|"foreground"|"background" (add: default the colour there),"opacity":0..100} → {"current"}. Edits the Gradient tool's current gradient (no layer, midpoints stay centred).

ajoutes.label: Get Document Preset
